title: Closure properties of the all-shifts affine projection-mate locus
statement: Use the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], their canonical K-flat tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] and direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image] of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For a morphism f, an adjunction p:Lf^*\dashv Rf_* with counit \epsilon and a natural isomorphism t:Lf^*(-\otimes^L-)\simeq Lf^*(-)\otimes^L Lf^*(-), write \pi_{p,t}(M,L) for the adjunction transpose of t_{M,Rf_*L} followed by 1_{Lf^*M}\otimes\epsilon_L. Let A be a commutative ring, Y=\operatorname{Spec} A, X a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme and f:X\to Y a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism, with p,t as above and L\in D_{QCoh}(X). Let e:D(A)\simeq D_{QCoh}(Y) be an equivalence whose composite with the ambient inclusion is triangulated for a compatible shift structure. The localization universe for D(A) may differ from the one for the two scheme derived categories. Define P(K) to mean: for every n\in\mathbf Z, every M\in D_{QCoh}(Y) and every isomorphism e(K[n])\simeq M in the ambient derived category, \pi_{p,t}(M,L) is invertible. Then P is closed under all coproducts indexed in the module universe, the third vertex of any distinguished triangle with its first two vertices in P, and retracts.

proof.text: Construct suppliedMate as a natural transformation using the adjunction Hom-equivalence naturality square, the supplied tensorator naturality, and tensor interchange. Extract triangulatedness of derivedPullback from exists_derivedPullback. For each tensorRight, choose a K-flat representative and use the proved upstream commShiftTensorRightQhObj and isTriangulated_tensorRightQhObj, then transport the exact shift structure along the representative isomorphism with Functor.CommShift.ofIso. This avoids a Grothendieck instance in the independent localization universe. Give direct image the shift induced by the supplied adjunction and apply right-adjoint triangulatedness. Compose both exact functors with the supplied exact ambient realization of e.

Replace the quantified isomorphism predicate by invertibility of the natural mate on the realized shifted objects, using NatTrans.isIso_app_iff_of_iso. The equivalence e preserves coproducts. DerivedQCohDirectSumsAux supplies ambient coproducts and quasi-coherent closure, so the quasi-coherent inclusion creates and preserves these coproducts. Pullback preserves coproducts as the supplied left adjoint; both tensorRight functors preserve them. Package each pulled-back and tensored object as a quasi-coherent object using derivedPullback_tensor_preserve_QCoh and canonical_derivedTensor_preserve_QCoh. Apply derivedDirectImagePreservesDirectSums to this family and transport the discrete diagram isomorphism to obtain coproduct preservation of the second composite. For every shift, map the supplied colimit cofan by the shift equivalence and apply isIso_app_coconePt_of_preservesColimit to the natural mate.

The private homological_triangle_comparison forms the five-term exact sequence from the distinguished triangle and its first two rotations, with arrows H(mor1), H(mor2), H(mor3), and H(-mor1[1]). The mate naturality supplies all four commuting squares, including the connecting arrow. Apply Mathlib Abelian.isIso_of_epi_of_isIso_of_isIso_of_mono. Compose the two triangulated functors with every preadditiveCoyoneda functor and use Yoneda to detect invertibility. Apply this argument to every shifted distinguished triangle. The four outer components are invertible by the all-shifts hypotheses, transporting double shifts with shiftFunctorAdd. No shift compatibility of the supplied tensorator or natural mate is assumed.

For every shift map the supplied object retract through the shift functor and use NatTrans.retractArrowApp for the realized mate. Apply stability of the isomorphism morphism property under retracts. Transport back to the original quantified-isomorphism predicate. The coproduct argument already covers an empty index type.
